answer_1.quote: We introduce the notion of structured summaries, or STRUCTSUM... focusing on tables and mind maps as possible STRUCTSUM instantiations...

answer_2.quote: We propose AUTO-QA as a coverage metric, in order to measure how much information from the original passage is retained in the STRUCTSUM...

answer_3.quote: We use a set of critics, implemented via prompts, to ensure sufficient quality across each dimension... (i) Factuality, (ii) Local Structure and (iii) Global Structure.

answer_4.quote: Human annotation accuracy at different pipeline stages... annotators were asked to rate each instance as "Good" or "Bad" by checking overall quality... We created a timed text‑comprehension user study with 12 volunteers.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated outputs as Good/Bad checking factuality and structural quality (e.g., table structure, column‑header match for tables; incomplete branches, main concept relevance, edge connections for mind maps).
